knowledge_point.title: Applying Row Operations To a Coefficients Matrix

question.:question/problem:
Consider the matrix $C,$ given by

$$
C=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 7 \\ -2 & 6 & 8\end{bmatrix}.
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the following row operations on $C?$

$$
\begin{aligned}{R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+2{R}_{2} \\ {R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+{R}_{3}\end{aligned}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Let's list the required operations:

- The operation ${R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+2{R}_{2}$ means that we need to add $2$ times the second row to the first row.

- The operation ${R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+{R}_{3}$ means that we need to add $1$ times the third row to the first row.

Applying the operations, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}C & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 7 \\ -2 & 6 & 8\end{bmatrix}\quad {R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+2{R}_{2} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}1+(2)(4) & 2+(2)(5) & 3+(2)(7) \\ 4 & 5 & 7 \\ -2 & 6 & 8\end{bmatrix} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}9 & 12 & 17 \\ 4 & 5 & 7 \\ -2 & 6 & 8\end{bmatrix}\quad {R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+{R}_{3} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}9+(1)(-2) & 12+(1)(6) & 17+(1)(8) \\ 4 & 5 & 7 \\ -2 & 6 & 8\end{bmatrix} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}7 & 18 & 25 \\ 4 & 5 & 7 \\ -2 & 6 & 8\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$
